body:
**Sprint 2 started** (orchestrator)

Sprint 1 approved; the approval covers the generated `.mcp.json` defaults (planner, `--allow-save`, `--label "Claude Code"`). No answers were recorded on the planner's open questions, so sprint 2 follows the plan's defaults: done board epics stay in Git history and are not imported, open epics import as drafts with their done sub-tickets listed in the intent rather than as tickets, and committing `.mcp.json` stays the person's call. DM-18 dispatched to an Opus worktree worker.
